$comment: Mutability is a CONCEPT, not a partition. A morph may edit ANY file under app_root — chat, scoreboard, components, styles, the App shell, even itself. The kernel (the machinery that runs + verifies morphs) is never editable. A morph only ships if the CHAT SURVIVES: it must still build, still render, and the post-morph app must still contain the chat anchors. Break the chat and the candidate loses — so your live chat can never be removed, only restyled.

chat_survival.note: The post-morph source under app_root must still contain these strings, or the chat is considered removed/broken and the candidate is rejected.
